column2: The asset: the royal castle keep of a storybook medieval capital: a massive square keep of chunky warm grey stone blocks, three storeys, crenellated parapet, a tall pointed roof of red clay tiles with two small corner turrets with red conical tile roofs, tall arched Gothic windows with warm glowing glass, a big arched wooden double door with iron studs at the top of a short flight of stone steps, two long plain cream off-white cloth banners hanging from the parapet either side of the door (blank, no emblem). Solid base sitting flat on the ground.

The asset: one straight modular section of a castle curtain wall, about three times as long as it is tall, chunky warm grey stone blocks, a walkway parapet with big square crenellations along the top, a few darker weathered stones and moss at the foot; both ends cut flat and square so identical sections butt together in a line; no towers, no gate, no banners. Shown from the outer side.

The asset: a round castle wall tower that stands between curtain wall sections: chunky warm grey stone blocks, a slightly wider crenellated top, a conical roof of red clay tiles with a small finial, two narrow arrow slits, one long plain cream off-white cloth banner hanging down its front (blank, no emblem). Solid base sitting flat on the ground.

The asset: a squat square castle corner tower with a crenellated top, chunky warm grey stone blocks, a low pyramid roof of orange-red clay tiles, two narrow arrow-slit windows, stone corbels under the parapet. Solid base sitting flat on the ground. No banners.
